purpose: Externalized discovery inputs and extraction rules for G01 native production-chain and DEX-derived network union.

sources.notes: Directory count is never treated as chain count. _non-cosmos records are retained for union processing.

sources.production_rule: retain as discovery candidate; lifecycle and canonical identity require independent verification
sources.notes: This is a discovery surface, not final production truth.

sources.selection: protocol records whose category is DEX-like OR whose name/category is explicitly exchange/AMM/orderbook
sources.production_rule: extract chain names from qualifying protocol records as DEX-derived network candidates
sources.notes: DEX-derived presence is a candidate signal only; venue capability and execution eligibility remain separate gates.

normalization.non_evm_policy: never coerce a native identifier into EVM semantics
normalization.alias_policy: retain aliases as evidence; resolve to canonical identity only after verification
normalization.testnet_policy: exclude from production denominator but preserve in exclusion registry
normalization.duplicate_policy: deduplicate only after identity and execution-plane reconciliation
